Probably the worst fine-dining experience.
Dec 2025 • Family
I made a reservation to specifically ask if they had any cake-sized dessert to throw a little bday surprise, they confirmed via phone call. Then after we finished main dishes I checked if the cake was ready, the staffs said there’s no cake because they changed to new menu. I asked them to recheck if there’s any solutions. No one responded to me and left me standing alone. I had to run downstair to the receptionist and raised the problem again. Then she said they only had a matcha mochi that they can put a candle on, which they would offer us a complimentary. 
And the bill came with full price, no discount or complimentary dessert as they proposed. 

New menu was somehow impressive but not mind-blowing.

Not recommended for anyone nor coming back again.

Delicious, well-executed and highly recommended!!!
Mar 2025 • Family
On our holiday, we had our last dinner at this incredible restaurant, which offers a set menu showcasing the best dishes from the top to the bottom of Vietnam. The 12-course experience was thoughtfully curated, with a little menu book detailing the traditional version of the dish that inspired each course. The explanations were clear and insightful, enhancing our understanding and enjoyment of each course.

Our party of six opted for the full 12-course menu, and the restaurant was very accommodating when three of us wanted to try two additional dishes. The staff were not only professional and friendly but also had a fantastic sense of humor, making the experience even more enjoyable.

Having opened in October 2023, this place is a hidden gem that deserves a Michelin star and should be ranked number one. As we were leaving, we had the pleasure of meeting the chef, who was just as warm and welcoming as the rest of the team. Highly recommended!

Great fine dining experience!
Oct 2024 • Couples
If you like fine dining Oryz is highly recommended! We had a choice of 13 or 15 courses and an arrangement of wine or sake. We chose 13 courses with sake, one Vietnamese sake arrangement and one Japanese, so we could both taste. 

13 courses may sound like a lot, but the proportions are perfect in my opinion. We were full, but not bulging. The courses represent a culinary journey and each dish is represented with the explanation of the different influences (including from China, Laos and Malaysia). 

The service is fast and top notch. Because we are mainly used to European cuisines at this level, it was a hugely positive surprise. 100/100 that we would still go back.

Precision and Respect in execution
Jun 2024 • Couples
Updated 14th July 2024

Back for the umpteenth time (I have lost count) and my oh my, Team Oryz has out-done themselves again!

I've journeyed from the first season and now in its 4th Season - It does not disappoint at all.

The Cho Lon Season is THE creme de la creme so far and its the season that gave them the nod of acknowledgment from Michelin. It has built upon the consistency, precision and good balance from the previous 3 seasons to birth this Tour De Force! 

The Respect shown to the genesis of each creation is thoroughly researched and the use of small boxes to explain the origins of the ingredients used in each dish, accompanied by the use of a QR code that allows the diner to read more about the ingredients changes this from a Gastronomical delight to one of a Journey through Vietnam and not just Cho Lon - Highly ingenious that shows the level of care, respect and nod to heritage that Chef Chris and team at Oryz pays attention to. 

This season felt more like a movie than a dining experience to be honest - A delight not just for the tastebuds and eyes with its visually captivating appearance - but also for the curious mind. 

You can truly feel the passion and depth of research and above all - RESPECT present. 

Its not just showmanship for the sake of it and neither is it pretentious, it is sincere, genuine and just simply good food with PRECISION - Which is how i come to describe Oryz in one word. 

As an individual of Chinese heritage and ethnic stock, there were many familiar flavors, yet at the same time, many new Vietnamese infused flavors that i discovered. 

All i could think about during the journey was - 

1) How did you manage to out-do yourselves again Chef Chris and team Oryz?!

And right now, I am eagerly awaiting the 5th Season

Well Done, keep innovating, keep pushing the boundaries and keep passion burning bright!

Kudos!

-----

Amazing creations by the Chef with subtle but expertly executed fusion dishes

Updated - 25th February 2024

3 months ago when i first had the opportunity to experience ORYZ through the recommendation of a friend, i was skeptical as having had many sub-par experiences with Fine Dining restaurants, i was expecting the same concept and dishes.

However 3 months on, I can indeed say i'm a real fan of Oryz for the following reasons.

I've tasted every single menu from the first season (experimental), second season (Sichuan inspired) and the current season (Hong Kong) - which is by far my favorite.

1) Constant Innovation and Creativity : The seasonal, thematic menus are a work of inspiration and creativity in itself. Many fine-dining establishments stick to what works and it sticks to what is comfortable.

No doubt this is a recipe for success however the menu gets tired.

Oryz sets itself apart not just by its PRECISION and ATTENTION TO DETAILS, but its spirit of CONSTANT and RELENTLESS innovation and going against the grain.

2) Relentless Innovation : Beef Pho interpreted as a dessert? Unthinkable! But executed with so much finesse and sensitivity that it in itself is a cheeky work of art.

Many of the dishes are rooted in tradition and are tastes we are all familiar with, however under Chef Chris's relentless pursuit of research, creativity and innovation, I am constantly amazed at how simple, childhood dishes can be levelled up into works of refined art that tastes similar to what is familiar, yet exciting and adventurous.

3) GREAT Teamwork : Oryz is helmed by Chef Chris, but his competent team of chefs, assistants and staff make the entire experience delightful.

To have a vision of one own is important, but to be able to translate it down to the last man, to share the same vision is leadership at a high calling and level.

Every dish is plated, presented and concocted with fine precision and attention to details that it is mind-boggling.

4) Wallet-friendly prices :

I've been to fine dining establishments that come close to the level of sophistication in the dishes at 2 -3x the price.

Oryz positions itself as a "Casual-fine dining" but the precision of dishes is anything but.

Expect great value, and great experiences as Oryz.

Oryz functions on a great model to build loyalty and repeat patrons, now that I have completed seasons 1-3, i am eagerly anticipating season 4 and beyond.

Great Job Chef Chris and team!

You deserve every customer that returns to Oryz

Michelin standard food in Saigon
May 2024 • Couples
Oryz - What an incredible dining experience!!!

Had the 12 course tasting menu. We were guided through Saigon to Cho Lon. Quoting Love Actually, so many “taste explosions” - as in flavours that have been carefully and perfectly put together, and you can’t help but have a foodgasm. 

They change their menu every 8 weeks and I am blown away by how much work that must entail to get to the standard they have. Dare I say, the leading contender for a Michelin star here!? We have some fantastic restaurants, but this one’s shining. 

Service also doesn’t get better than that. Each course was passionately explained. The use of a box to display one of the main ingredients is a lovely touch. Showcasing food without being too poncey. The theatre was there, just didn’t feel awkward. 

I was going to add a load of photos, but actually I don’t want to spoil it for those who are going.

Thank you, ORYZ Saigon
